versions.changelog: Added 'Configuring the API Key for OpenClaw Gateway' section with systemd override, Docker, and verification instructions
Security fix: eliminate shell/Python injection in build_payload. All variables now passed via environment to a heredoc Python script — zero variable interpolation in code context.
Fix: rename glm-search to glm-search.sh so ClawHub includes it in the file manifest. Previous versions had the runtime script silently dropped.
Declare python3 in required bins. Document npx as optional dependency for mcporter.
Fix credential documentation accuracy: clearly distinguish cURL mode (no disk writes) from MCP mode (writes config with key). Remove misleading claims. Recommend cURL mode for security.

Security hardening: API key from env var only, restrictive file permissions, clear credential audit. New: cURL backend (preferred, no mcporter needed), intent recognition, full parameter support, auto-backend selection.
Initial release: Zhipu GLM web search via official MCP broker endpoint. Multi-engine support (Pro/Sogou/Quark/Std), one-command setup, works from China.
